tools.name: searchCruises
tools.description: Search all cruise offers by free text: a destination (e.g. Karibik, Nordkap, Mittelmeer), a ship name (e.g. Mein Schiff 6, AIDAnova), a port, or a numeric offer number. Returns the matching cruise result page.

search.description: Search term: destination, ship name, port, or offer number. 3 to 80 characters.
